description: SE Ranking offers a credit-based Data API and a Project API for SEO data and project automation.
auth_notes: A single secret API key authenticates all Data API and Project API endpoints.
gate_detail: A 14-day free trial gives 100K credits and an API key after email confirmation. Ongoing use needs a subscription plan, pay-as-you-go credit pack (from $50), API add-on or standalone plan.
api_scope: Data API for keyword, backlink, domain and audit data billed in credits, plus a Project API for managing sites, keywords and audits within subscription limits.
mcp_notes: Remote MCP server centrally hosted and managed by SE Ranking; documented with 180+ tools. URL not shown in the sources.
blocker_detail: Production use depends on a paid plan or credit purchase; the free trial credits expire after 14 days.

evidence.quote: A single API key authenticates every endpoint across the Data API and the Project API.
The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as  MCP server access.
Your API key is issued immediately after payment. If you are on a free trial, you’ll get an API key once you confirm your email.
Pay-as-you-go (PAYG): Credit packs that never expire. From $50 for 250,000 credits, with no limit on how many you buy.
The MCP server is centrally hosted and managed by SE Ranking.
Credits are the unit SE Ranking uses to bill API usage.

uncertainties: REST style is not explicitly labeled in the sources.
MCP server URL is not shown in the sources.
Webhooks and sandbox are not mentioned.
